facts.business: Suyog Gurbaxani Funicular Ropeways Limited develops, constructs, operates and maintains funicular ropeway infrastructure on a BOT basis, primarily serving pilgrimage and tourism destinations, and also provides visitor amenities such as accommodation, shopping, food courts, parking and recreational services.
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with directors (remuneration, loans taken/repaid), relatives of KMP (loans taken/repaid, interest charged), and subsidiary Supreme Suyog Funicular Ropeways Pvt Ltd. All transactions were on arm's length basis and in ordinary course of business except as disclosed in Form AOC-2.
